hookups.source: No operator page exists (rockridgecampground.com is a parked domain, read 2026-10-22). The stored 50 A / water / sewer were derived from note prose resting only on directory listings (Wilson Chamber, Campendium), so they are cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the pull-through value rests only on directory listings; no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

facilities.source: Same as hookups: laundry and dump rest only on directory listings; no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

note: Rural campground near Sims, about 5 miles off I-95; directory listings (not the operator) describe full and water/electric sites, a pool and a fishing pond. No website of its own (the old domain is parked); camper reviews from 2022-2024 describe mostly long-term residents. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine: rockridgecampground.com redirects to a domain-parking lander, and the RoverPass listing is unclaimed (isBookable false, request-only). Google Maps: Rock Ridge Campground, 7030 Rock Ridge School Rd, Sims, 3.9 stars / 115 reviews, phone 252-291-4477 (matches), no website. No 2024+ operator rate (camper report $35, Nov 2024). Cleared directory-only hookups, pull-through, laundry and dump. Good Sam false left as derived. No gateway within 40 km (Raleigh 51 km); not stayed at. Note rewritten: dropped the field restatements and the unsupported 'operates transient'.
flags: Long-stay / workforce test: no posted nightly rate, no booking engine and no website, and camper reports describe a long-stay park: Nov 25 2024 'mostly long-term campers' (and a reservation given away at check-in); Aug 2 2024 a caller was told spots go 'only to construction workers and traveling nurses'; Sep 2022 'a good number of full-time residents'; June 24 2026 the phone went to a full voicemail and the website was a spam page (Campendium reviews, secondary). Fails long-stay test 2 (no posted nightly price, no booking engine) and looks workforce-oriented. Candidate for removal; AWH to decide.
Dead website: https://www.rockridgecampground.com is a parked domain (JS redirect to /lander, a search-domainparking page). Google Maps lists no website.
Unclaimed RoverPass listing (roverpass.com/c/rock-ridge-campground-sims-nc, isBookable false) - not a booking channel.
